    (hperp : ⟪a, e⟫ = (0 : ℝ)) (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) :
    ‖perp (a + t • e) (a + (s * t) • e)‖ < ‖a‖

name: chapter11.SylvesterGallaiCore.norm_perp_lt
statement:
theorem norm_perp_lt {a e : V} {t : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (he : e ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (hperp : ⟪a, e⟫ = (0 : ℝ)) :
    ‖perp (a + t • e) a‖ < ‖a‖

name: chapter11.SylvesterGallaiCore.norm_perp_sq
statement:
theorem norm_perp_sq {w : V} (hw : w ≠ 0) (z : V) :
    ‖perp w z‖ ^ 2 = ‖z‖ ^ 2 - ⟪z, w⟫ ^ 2 / ‖w‖ ^ 2

name: chapter11.SylvesterGallaiCore.not_mem_line
statement:
theorem not_mem_line {A e : V} {x y : ℝ} (hA : A ≠ 0) (he : e ≠ 0)
    (hperp : ⟪A, e⟫ = (0 : ℝ)) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    ¬ ∃ c : ℝ, A + x • e = c • (A + y • e)

name: chapter11.SylvesterGallaiCore.perp_add
statement: theorem perp_add (w z₁ z₂ : V) : perp w (z₁ + z₂) = perp w z₁ + perp w z₂

name: chapter11.SylvesterGallaiCore.perp_self
statement: theorem perp_self {w : V} (hw : w ≠ 0) : perp w w = 0

name: chapter11.SylvesterGallaiCore.perp_smul
statement: theorem perp_smul (w : V) (c : ℝ) (z : V) : perp w (c • z) = c • perp w z

name: dalembert_lemma
statement:
theorem dalembert_lemma {p : Polynomial ℂ} (hp : p.natDegree > 0)
    {a : ℂ} (hpa : p.eval a ≠ 0) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
    ∃ b, ‖b - a‖ < R ∧ ‖p.eval b‖ < ‖p.eval a‖

name: fundamental_theorem_of_algebra
statement:
theorem fundamental_theorem_of_algebra (p : Polynomial ℂ) (hp : p.natDegree > 0) :
    ∃ z : ℂ, p.eval z = 0

name: chapter28.avg_divisor_count_le_harmonic
statement:
theorem avg_divisor_count_le_harmonic (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (Nat.divisors j).card : ℚ) ≤
    ↑n * ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (1 : ℚ) / ↑i

name: chapter28.avg_divisor_count_lower_bound
statement:
theorem avg_divisor_count_lower_bound (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ↑n * ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (1 : ℚ) / ↑i - ↑n <
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (Nat.divisors j).card : ℚ)

name: chapter28.brouwer_fixed_point_2d
statement:
theorem brouwer_fixed_point_2d
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))

name: chapter28.brouwer_fixed_point_2d_from_sperner

    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))

name: chapter28.c4_free_edge_bound
statement:
theorem c4_free_edge_bound
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hC4 : ∀ (a b c d : V), a ≠ b → a ≠ c → a ≠ d → b ≠ c → b ≠ d → c ≠ d →
      ¬(G.Adj a b ∧ G.Adj b c ∧ G.Adj c d ∧ G.Adj d a))
    (n : ℕ) (hn : Fintype.card V = n) :
    G.edgeFinset.card ≤ ⌊(n : ℝ) / 4 * (1 + Real.sqrt (4 * n - 3))⌋₊

name: chapter28.claim1_coprime
statement:
theorem claim1_coprime (n : ℕ)
    (S : Finset (Fin (2 * n))) (hS : n < S.card) :
    ∃ a ∈ S, ∃ b ∈ S, a ≠ b ∧ Nat.Coprime (a.val + 1) (b.val + 1)

name: chapter28.claim2_divisible
statement:
theorem claim2_divisible (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (S : Finset ℕ)
    (hS_sub : ∀ x ∈ S, 1 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 2 * n)
    (hS_card : S.card = n + 1) :
    ∃ a ∈ S, ∃ b ∈ S, a ≠ b ∧ a ∣ b

name: chapter28.claim4_contiguous_sum
statement:
theorem claim4_contiguous_sum (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (a : Fin n → ℤ) :
    ∃ (l r : Fin n), l ≤ r ∧ (n : ℤ) ∣ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc l r, a i

name: chapter28.double_counting
statement:
theorem double_counting {α β : Type*}
    (R : Finset α) (C : Finset β) (r : α → β → Prop) [∀ a b, Decidable (r a b)] :
    (∑ p ∈ R, (Finset.bipartiteAbove r C p).card) =
    (∑ q ∈ C, (Finset.bipartiteBelow r R q).card)

name: chapter28.handshaking
statement: lemma handshaking : ∑ v, d(v) = 2 * #E

name: chapter28.orthogonal_both_eq_cross

lemma orthogonal_both_eq_cross {F : Type*} [Field F] [DecidableEq F]

name: chapter28.orthogonal_set_card
statement:
lemma orthogonal_set_card [Fintype (PG2 p)]
    (v : PG2 p) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : PG2 p => Projectivization.orthogonal v w)).card = p + 1

name: chapter28.pigeon_hole_principle
statement:
theorem pigeon_hole_principle (n r : ℕ) (h : r < n) (object_to_boxes : Fin n → Fin r) :
  ∃ box : Fin r, ∃ object₁ object₂ : Fin n,
  object₁ ≠ object₂ ∧
  object_to_boxes object₁ = box ∧
  object_to_boxes object₂ = box

name: chapter28.reimanGraph_card_vertices
statement:
theorem reimanGraph_card_vertices :
    Nat.card (PG2 p) = p ^ 2 + p + 1

name: chapter28.reimanGraph_degree_eq
statement:
lemma reimanGraph_degree_eq [Fintype (PG2 p)] [DecidableEq (PG2 p)]
    [DecidableRel (reimanGraph p).Adj] (v : PG2 p) :
    (reimanGraph p).degree v =
      if Projectivization.orthogonal v v then p else p + 1

name: chapter28.reimanGraph_no_C4
statement:
theorem reimanGraph_no_C4 :
    ∀ (a b c d : PG2 p),
      a ≠ c → b ≠ d →
      ¬((reimanGraph p).Adj a b ∧ (reimanGraph p).Adj b c ∧
        (reimanGraph p).Adj c d ∧ (reimanGraph p).Adj d a)

name: chapter28.sum_choose_deg_le_choose_card
statement:
theorem sum_choose_deg_le_choose_card
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hC4 : ∀ (a b c d : V), a ≠ b → a ≠ c → a ≠ d → b ≠ c → b ≠ d → c ≠ d →
      ¬(G.Adj a b ∧ G.Adj b c ∧ G.Adj c d ∧ G.Adj d a)) :
    ∑ v : V, (G.degree v).choose 2 ≤ (Fintype.card V).choose 2

name: chapter28.sum_divisor_count
statement:
theorem sum_divisor_count (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (Nat.divisors j).card = ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, n / i

name: cell_subset_tile_of_center_mem

lemma exists_additive_map_of_irrational (a : ℝ) (ha : Irrational a) :

lemma exists_additive_map_of_irrational_ratio (w h : ℝ) (h_irr : Irrational (w / h)) :

name: f_area_add_height
statement:
lemma f_area_add_height (f : ℝ →+ ℝ) (r1 r2 : Rectangle) (h_width : r1.w = r2.w) :
  f_area f ⟨r1.x, r1.y, r1.w, r1.h + r2.h, r1.w_pos, by linarith [r1.h_pos, r2.h_pos]⟩ =

lemma f_area_add_width (f : ℝ →+ ℝ) (r1 r2 : Rectangle) (h_height : r1.h = r2.h) :
  f_area f ⟨r1.x, r1.y, r1.w + r2.w, r1.h, by linarith [r1.w_pos, r2.w_pos], r1.h_pos⟩ =

name: f_area_sum_tiling

lemma f_area_sum_tiling (f : ℝ →+ ℝ) (R : Rectangle) (Ts : List Rectangle) (h : is_tiling R Ts) :

name: filter_flatMap_split
statement:
lemma filter_flatMap_split {α β : Type} (l : List α) (f : α → List β) (p : β → Bool) (q : α → Bool)
  (r : β → Bool) (h : ∀ a, ∀ b ∈ f a, p b = (q a && r b)) :
  (l.flatMap f).filter p = (l.filter q).flatMap (fun a => (f a).filter r)

name: filter_zip_eq_zip_filter
statement:
lemma filter_zip_eq_zip_filter (l : List ℝ) (hl : l.Pairwise (· < ·)) (p : ℝ → Prop)
  [DecidablePred p] (h_convex : ∀ x y z, x ∈ l → y ∈ l → z ∈ l → x < y → y < z → p x → p z → p y) :
  (l.filter p).zip (l.filter p).tail = ((l.zip l.tail).filter (fun (x, y) => p x ∧ p y))

name: grid_cell_no_cross_x
statement:
lemma grid_cell_no_cross_x (g : Grid) (c : Rectangle) (hc : c ∈ g.cells) (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ g.xs) :

name: grid_f_area_sum
statement:
lemma grid_f_area_sum (f : ℝ →+ ℝ) (g : Grid) :
  (g.cells.map (f_area f)).sum = f (g.xs.getLast g.xs_ne_nil - g.xs.head g.xs_ne_nil) *
    f (g.ys.getLast g.ys_ne_nil - g.ys.head g.ys_ne_nil)

name: grid_squares_disjoint
statement:
lemma grid_squares_disjoint (x y s : ℝ) (m n : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) :
  let squares := grid_squares x y s m n hs
  ∀ i j : Fin squares.length, i ≠ j → (squares.get i).interior ∩ (squares.get j).interior = ∅

name: grid_squares_is_tiling
statement:
lemma grid_squares_is_tiling (R : Rectangle) (s : ℝ) (m n : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s)
  (hw : R.w = m * s) (hh : R.h = n * s) :
  is_tiling R (grid_squares R.x R.y s m n hs)

name: grid_squares_union
statement:
lemma grid_squares_union (R : Rectangle) (s : ℝ) (m n : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s)
  (hw : R.w = m * s) (hh : R.h = n * s) :
  let squares := grid_squares R.x R.y s m n hs
  (⋃ t ∈ squares, t.toSet) = R.toSet

name: head_filter_interval_eq_left
statement:
lemma head_filter_interval_eq_left (l : List ℝ) (hl : l.Pairwise (· < ·)) (a b : ℝ)

name: integral_f_eq_zero_iff_int_side

lemma integral_rectangle_eq_integral_interior (r : Rectangle) :

name: integral_union_rectangles
statement:
lemma integral_union_rectangles (Ts : List Rectangle)

  ∫ p in (⋃ t ∈ Ts, t.toSet), f p = (Ts.map (fun t => ∫ p in t.toSet, f p)).sum

name: irrational_linear_independent

name: last_filter_interval_eq_right

name: rational_ratio_of_tiling

name: rectangle_tiling_integer_side

name: subgrid_bounds
statement:
lemma subgrid_bounds (g : Grid) (r : Rectangle)
  (hx1 : r.x ∈ g.xs) (hx2 : r.x + r.w ∈ g.xs)
  (hy1 : r.y ∈ g.ys) (hy2 : r.y + r.h ∈ g.ys) :
  (subgrid g r hx1 hy1).xs.head (by
    have := (subgrid g r hx1 hy1).xs_ne_nil
    exact this) = r.x ∧
  (subgrid g r hx1 hy1).xs.getLast (by
    have := (subgrid g r hx1 hy1).xs_ne_nil
    exact this) = r.x + r.w ∧
  (subgrid g r hx1 hy1).ys.head (by
    have := (subgrid g r hx1 hy1).ys_ne_nil
    exact this) = r.y ∧
  (subgrid g r hx1 hy1).ys.getLast (by
    have := (subgrid g r hx1 hy1).ys_ne_nil
    exact this) = r.y + r.h

name: sum_cells_in_rect_eq_f_area
statement:
lemma sum_cells_in_rect_eq_f_area (f : ℝ →+ ℝ) (g : Grid) (r : Rectangle)

  (hy1 : r.y ∈ g.ys) (hy2 : r.y + r.h ∈ g.ys) :
  ((cells_in_rect g r).map (f_area f)).sum = f_area f r

name: sum_f_diffs_eq
statement:
lemma sum_f_diffs_eq (f : ℝ →+ ℝ) (l : List ℝ) (hl : l ≠ []) :

name: tiling_iff_rational_ratio

name: union_subset_cells_in_rect

name: chapter30.erdos_ko_rado

theorem erdos_ko_rado {n : ℕ} {𝒜 : Finset (Finset (Fin n))} {k : ℕ}

name: chapter30.hall_marriage
statement:
theorem hall_marriage {ι : Type*} {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]

name: chapter30.sperner

name: card_exponents_le

lemma card_exponents_le (n d : ℕ) :

name: coeff_linePoly_eq_homogeneousComponent_eval
dim_restrictTotalDegree

name: eval_homogeneousComponent_eq_zero_of_forall_eval_line_eq_zero
statement:
lemma eval_homogeneousComponent_eq_zero_of_forall_eval_line_eq_zero

name: eval_linePoly

name: exponents_le_finite

name: lemma_35_1
statement:
theorem lemma_35_1 {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] {n : ℕ}
  {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) F} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    Fintype.card {x : Fin n → F // MvPolynomial.eval x p = 0} ≤
    p.totalDegree * (Fintype.card F) ^ (n - 1)

name: lemma_35_1_aux
statement:
lemma lemma_35_1_aux {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] (n : ℕ)
  (IH : ∀ (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) F) (_ : p ≠ 0),
    Fintype.card {x : Fin n → F // MvPolynomial.eval x p = 0} ≤
    p.totalDegree * (Fintype.card F) ^ (n - 1))
  (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) F) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
  Fintype.card {x : Fin (n + 1) → F // MvPolynomial.eval x p = 0} ≤
  p.totalDegree * (Fintype.card F) ^ n

name: lemma_35_2
statement:
theorem lemma_35_2 {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F] {n d : ℕ} {E : Set (Fin n → F)}
    (hE : (@Set.toFinset _ E (Fintype.ofFinite ↑E)).card < (n + d).choose n) :
    ∃ p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) F, p ∈ MvPolynomial.restrictTotalDegree (Fin n) F d ∧ p ≠ 0 ∧
    ∀ x ∈ E, MvPolynomial.eval x p = 0

name: natDegree_linePoly_le

name: restrictTotalDegree_eq_span

name: theorem_35_3
statement:
theorem theorem_35_3 {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]

name: theorem_35_3'
statement:
theorem theorem_35_3' {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]

statement:
theorem MeasureTheory.measure_biUnion_lt_sum_of_inter {β : Type _}
  [MeasurableSpace β] [MeasurableSingletonClass β] [DecidableEq β]
  {P : Measure β} [IsFiniteMeasure P] (s : Finset α) (t : α → Finset β)
  (h : ∃ i j : s, i ≠ j ∧  P (t i ∩ t j) ≠ 0)
  : P (s.biUnion t) < ∑ x ∈ s, P (t x)

  (∀ A ∈ 𝓕, A.card = d) ∧  ¬ two_colorable 𝓕

statement:

  (h₁ : two_colorable 𝓕)  (h₂ : 𝓢 ⊆ 𝓕) : two_colorable 𝓢

name: chapter45.theorem_1
statement:
theorem theorem_1 {h_d : d ≥ 2} (𝓕 : Finset (Finset X))
  (H_𝓕 : ∀ (A : Finset X), A ∈ 𝓕 → A.card = d)
  : 𝓕.card ≤ 2 ^ (d-1) → two_colorable 𝓕
